meta.name: Dead Money
meta.description: Professional poker player Andy and his girlfriend, Chloe, are thrust into a dangerous 24-hour ordeal after a home poker game is robbed. When Andy impulsively steals the cash back from an inside-job robbery orchestrated by a local debtor, the criminals track him down and kidnap Chloe. To save her life and win back the money, Andy is forced to play in the highest-stakes poker game of his life.
